SYNTHETIC_GROUND_TRUTH_CLASSIFICATION.purpose: Classification performance under known synthetic truth.

INPUT_ADMISSIBILITY.purpose: Characterize whether a planned series is eligible for AFINO before classification.

SELECTION_FUNCTION.purpose: Prospectively characterize eligibility and selection probabilities over the frozen domain.

PERIOD_RECOVERY.purpose: Measure period recovery separately from classification.
PERIOD_RECOVERY.nonselection_rule: Formal M1 centers from non-selected cases are not period recovery.

NUMERICAL_STABILITY.truth_basis: optimizer repetitions on a deterministic prespecified subset
NUMERICAL_STABILITY.purpose: Quantify seed/numerical variability without conflating it with classification accuracy.

DEVELOPMENT_RULE_SELECTION.purpose: Allow candidate-rule development only if prospectively permitted by policy.

HELDOUT_VALIDATION.purpose: Single-use independent validation after final rule freeze.

EMPIRICAL_REALISM_DIAGNOSTIC.purpose: May later compare synthetic nuisance properties with observational summaries without supplying truth labels.

cross_plane_rules: INPUT_INADMISSIBLE is never recoded as NOT_SELECTED.
Classification performance conditional on eligible input is separate from end-to-end recovery over all planned simulations.
Period recovery is separate from classification.
Numerical stability is separate from classification accuracy.
Development rule selection cannot access held-out data.
Held-out validation is single-use and cannot be tuned after inspection.
Observational reference labels never define synthetic truth.
